title: Inertial cube flip, chute run and pocket recovery
summary: A cube rests on a raised launch surface. With a short push from the pusher blade, tip it over so that the face that initially faces the robot (-x) ends up on top, the cube completing the tip by its own momentum after the blade has let go, and let it settle. Then push the flipped cube onto an inclined chute, let it slide down by itself, meet it with the blade on its downhill side near the chute's lower end, and bring it to rest in the pocket at the bottom of the chute with the same face still on top.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.40, 0, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). Its hand carries a small blue pusher blade: a box 8 mm thick (tool x) x 50 mm wide (tool y) x 12 mm tall (tool z), centred at the tool frame origin; its pushing faces are normal to the tool x axis. The blade hangs from a rigid side adapter (part of the tool): from the hand a horizontal bar at tool z = 0.035 runs from tool x = -0.12 to 0 at tool y = +0.13, then along y to y = 0.07, ending in a short 12 mm x 12 mm post at (0, 0.07) reaching down from z = 0.036 to z = 0 (the blade's mid-height); the post stands 45 mm beyond the blade's +y end and is not joined to it visibly, but blade, bars and post are one rigid tool. The Panda TCP is at (-0.12, 0.13, 0.04) in the tool frame, so with the blade level the gripper points straight down. At the start the blade is level (tool axes aligned with the world axes, pushing faces normal to world x), its centre at (-0.05, -0.08, 0.179).
scene: An orange cube (44 mm edge) rests at t = 0 on a raised, flat orange launch surface (a slab 0.28 m along x by 0.18 m, on posts), one face toward the robot. The launch surface's far (+x) edge meets the top of a straight inclined grey chute (a trough with a 0.10 m wide floor and 22 mm side walls) that runs downhill in +x; the chute's top edge lies slightly below the launch surface. At the chute's low end sits a blue shallow pocket (an open box 0.12 m x 0.12 m inside with 12 mm walls), open on the side facing the chute, its floor flush with the chute's end. Friction is high enough that a cube at rest on the chute stays put, but a cube already sliding on it keeps sliding and speeds up by itself. Nothing moves at t = 0. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Cube: half-extent `cube_half` = 0.022 m, mass `object_mass` = 0.05 kg, friction 0.65 (dynamic 0.5525), restitution 0.3. At reset it is at (0.035 + dx, dy, 0.14 + `cube_half` + 0.0005) = (0.035 + dx, dy, 0.1625), identity orientation, at rest; dx ~ U(-`start_jitter_x`, `start_jitter_x`) (= 0 at nominal) and then dy ~ U(-`start_jitter_y`, `start_jitter_y`) = U(-0.004, 0.004) m, both drawn at reset. Launch surface: static box 0.28 x 0.18 x 0.04 m centred at (0.02, 0, 0.12) (top z = 0.14, x -0.12..0.16, y -0.09..0.09), friction 0.65, two support posts. Chute: static channel whose floor top surface runs from (0.16, 0, 0.138) to (0.36, 0, 0.035), length 0.225 m, slope 27.25 deg, floor half-width 0.05 m, walls 8 mm thick and 0.022 m tall, friction `chute_friction` = 0.47; surface normal (0.4579, 0, 0.8890), downhill unit vector (0.8890, 0, -0.4579). Mean cube/chute static friction 0.56 > tan 27.25 deg = 0.515 > mean dynamic friction 0.476. Pocket: static open box, inner half-size 0.06 m, walls 12 mm high and 5 mm thick, open on its -x side, floor top at z = 0.035, centre (0.41, 0); friction 0.4, restitution 0.03. Announced at reset: `goal_goal` = (0.41, 0, 0.035 + `cube_half`) = (0.41, 0, 0.057) (pocket centre at resting height) and the flag `target_face` = (-1, 0, 0) (not in the observation). Phase parameters: `free_slide` = 0.12 m, `incoming_speed` = 0.33 m/s. Along-chute coordinate of the cube: s = (p - (0.16, 0, 0.138)) . (0.8890, 0, -0.4579). Pusher: `tool_mass` = 0.2 kg, `tool_friction` = 0.3, restitution 0.05; `tool_half` = 0.07 sets only the adapter post's offset. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08.

phases.name: momentum_face_flip
phases.text: let tilt be the angle between the cube's initially vertical axis and world up. The blade's last contact with the cube must end while the tilt is between 0.03 and pi/4 - 0.02 = 0.765 rad (1.7 to 43.9 deg), and at some step more than 20 ms after that last contact the cube must still turn faster than 0.4 rad/s (an early release); the tilt must then pass pi/4 (45 deg) without further blade contact. After that the cube must lie with its original -x face on top (that face's outward normal within 0.18 rad of world +z), moving at less than 0.05 m/s and turning at less than 0.3 rad/s, touching the launch surface, for 0.25 s without interruption. Touching the cube with the blade again after the early release and before the tilt has passed 45 deg fails the task (flip_recontact_before_balance).

phases.name: oriented_chute_entry
phases.text: the cube touches the chute while its centre is at world x > 0.18 m and its original -x face points away from the chute surface (that face's outward normal within 0.35 rad (20.1 deg) of the chute surface's normal). The cube's position along the chute's downhill direction at that moment is recorded as the start of its free slide.

phases.name: downstream_intercept
phases.text: the phase completes at a step where the cube touches the blade and at the same time: the cube's centre is at world x > 0.32 m; the cube touches the chute; the blade's tool-frame origin lies on the downhill side of the cube's centre (positive component along the chute's downhill direction); since the start of its free slide the cube's centre has moved at least `free_slide` = 0.12 m along the chute's downhill direction; and on the previous physics step the cube's velocity component down the chute was at least `incoming_speed` = 0.33 m/s. Any cube-blade contact that does not meet all of these restarts the free slide from the cube's current position.

phases.name: pocket_delivery
phases.text: the cube touches the pocket, its centre is within 0.04 m (horizontal distance) of the pocket's centre, its original -x face is on top (outward normal within 0.18 rad of world +z), it moves at less than 0.04 m/s and turns at less than 0.2 rad/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task.

task_failures: flip_recontact_before_balance: during momentum_face_flip, the blade touches the cube after an early release has been registered and before the cube's tilt has passed 45 deg.
contact_rules: Only the pusher (blade, adapter bars and post) may touch anything, and it may touch only the cube: touching the launch surface, the chute, the pocket or the table is forbidden. No other part of the robot, the fingers included, may touch anything, the cube included.
world_goals_fixed: Chute-entry line: cube centre at world x > 0.18 m (oriented_chute_entry). Intercept line: cube centre at world x > 0.32 m (downstream_intercept). The delivery target is the pocket's centre (a physical fixture).
world_goals_seeded: `goal_goal` is the pocket's centre, announced at reset (a fixture's position: privileged mode only).
difficulty_note: The flip needs a short, well-dosed push that is released early so the cube finishes the tip by its own momentum without being touched again; on the chute the cube speeds up by itself and must be met on its downhill side at speed after a contact-free slide, then stopped in a shallow pocket without tumbling onto another face.
standard_notes: Nothing moves at t = 0: the cube rests on the launch surface with one face toward the robot. Once on the chute the cube slides and speeds up by itself, and a cube entering the pocket fast can tumble onto another face.
